_template_notes.story_sizing: Each story should be completable in ONE context window — roughly 200 lines of code changes max. If bigger, split it.
_template_notes.priority_order: 1 = highest. RALPH picks the lowest-numbered non-passing story. Dependencies must have lower priority numbers.
_template_notes.test_command: Must return exit code 0 on pass, non-zero on fail. RALPH uses this to verify before committing.
_template_notes.acceptance_criteria: Every criterion must be checkable by running a command, reading a file, or running a test. No subjective criteria.
